note: What goes into the standalone Android bundle (build/www). Edit this file instead of the build script.

exclude.reason: not referenced by any code (the donation banner image comes from the optional imageUrl setting); about 2 MB
not referenced by any code; about 390 KB

extraVendor.why: QR code of the 2-step-verification setup (js/totp.js loads it lazily; inside the app only this local copy is used). Pinned to 1.4.4 on purpose: it is the last qrcode release whose npm package contains the ready-made browser file build/qrcode.min.js (1.5.x publish no build/ folder), and cdnjs does not host this package at all - the old cdnjs URL answered HTTP 404 and stopped every build. If you change the version, js/totp.js must use the same one (tests/web-build.test.js checks that).

removeFromIndex.why: the app is not an installable website and manifest.json is not part of the bundle

websiteOnlyHostsNote: Only reached by website code paths (js/totp.js CDN fallbacks). Inside the app the QR library comes from the bundle (extraVendor).
